HTMLRemote: Empower Device Control with Your Custom HTML GUI

Transform the way you interact with devices in your local area network (LAN) using your own HTML GUI. This cutting-edge app allows you to harness the power of your personally crafted HTML/CSS/Javascript graphical user interface (GUI) to seamlessly control and manage devices within your network.

Key Features:
1.	Customized HTML Control: Design and implement your own HTML GUI to control devices effortlessly. Tailor the interface to suit your specific needs and preferences.
2.	LAN Device Management: HTMLRemote puts the control of devices in your LAN at your fingertips. Manage your devices from a centralized and customizable HTML interface.
3.	User-Friendly Configuration: As HTML developer, set up your devices with ease. HTMLRemote simplifies the configuration process, allowing you to integrate your devices seamlessly with your HTML GUI. Use the javeascript executeCommand function to send your commands en receive the response from your device. Use our sample pages to learn how to easily connect the executeCommand function to your buttons.
4.	Real-Time Device Monitoring: Keep a watchful eye on your devices in real time. Monitor their status, receive updates, and make instant adjustments using your personalized HTML control panel.
5.	Enhanced Security: HTMLRemote prioritizes the security of your device control. Benefit from a secure and private environment while enjoying the convenience of remote device management.
6.	MyURemote** included. Free Universal AV GUI Included: HTMLRemote comes with the universal AV GUI for audiovisual enthusiasts. Elevate your control experience for your AV devices with the MyURemote GUI, provided free of charge. (Url setting: http://wwwmyuremote.com/userconfig)

How to Use:
1.	Create Your HTML GUI: Design a customized HTML interface that suits your control preferences and aesthetic preferences. Use our sample pages to learn how to easily integrate socket communication into your GUI using the javascript executecommand function // or create a MyURemote account and configure your own AV Remote **
2.	Upload your HTML:  Upload your HTML GUI to a server of your choice.
3.	Connect: Easily connect the URL of your GUI with HTMLRemote. Goto the settings of your iOS device, scroll to HTMLRemote and fill in the URL in the Url field. (AV lovers who want to use the free MyURemote GUI, use the standard setting "http://www.myuremote.com/userconfig")
4.	Map Devices to GUI Elements: Intuitively map each device to its corresponding element on your HTML GUI for a seamless control experience.
5.	Effortless Device Control: Interact with your devices in real time using the controls you've crafted on your HTML interface. Switch between devices, adjust settings, and monitor status using.
6.	Expand Your Control Center: As your device system grows, HTMLRemote allows you to expand your control center effortlessly, adapting your HTML GUI to accommodate new devices.

Revolutionize your LAN device control with HTMLRemote, where your custom HTML GUI becomes the command center for all your connected devices. Experience the freedom of personalized control and elevate your home automation or network management to new heights


**check www.myuremote.com: MyURemote is a powerful smart remote app with an easy to use interface. It supports a wide variety of remote control systems, from direct IP control, as well as IR or RS232 (e.g. Global Cache controllers using your network).
MyURemote comes with a great set of features designed to make your Audio Video setup as user-friendly as possible.
